Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The Executive Hearing Office paragraph begins on the previous page; only the timing and general-information points printed on the first selected page are taught, and the office phone number is not taught [A01].
The power steering failure example and the brake failure steps on the second selected page are taught as printed; no outside vehicle-specific advice is added [A02].
The compromise example on the last selected page has a misspelled word in the extracted text; its meaning is clear and it is taught in plain words [A03].
Skid recovery is taught exactly as the manual words it, turning toward the intended path, which the manual equates with the direction of the skid [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.
